AI.SettingHint: Default for units whose 'AI Controlled' checkbox was never touched: hostile units act automatically on their turns (advance, attack, overwatch, flee when badly wounded). Units with the checkbox set always follow it. Runs on the GM client.
AI.SheetAiHint: The AI plays this unit's turns automatically. Neutrals just hold their ground.

UiToggle.Title: Toggle Foundry interface
UiToggle.KeybindHint: Hides or shows Foundry's standard interface (tools, players list, navigation, hotbar, sidebar).

Keys.Hint: Acts for your controlled unit (or the active unit) in combat.

Hud.Title: Tactical Actions
Hud.SelectHint: Select a unit to see tactical actions.
Hud.MoveModeHint: Click a highlighted tile to move. ESC to cancel.
Hud.TargetingHint: Click an enemy to target and attack it. ESC to cancel.
Hud.OverwatchModeHint: Click to set the overwatch cone — enemies entering it are shot. ESC to cancel.
Hud.NoTarget: No target — aim at an enemy first (T key or double-click).

Notif.NoActor: That token has no unit sheet.
Notif.NotOwner: You do not control that unit.
Notif.NotYourTurn: It is not that unit's turn.
Notif.OutOfRange: Target is out of weapon range.
Notif.NoLOS: No line of sight to target.
Notif.HexUnsupported: Hex grids are not supported yet — use a square grid scene.
Notif.PropInert: The shot thunks into the barrel — nothing happens.

Cover.Name: Cover Height
Cover.Hint: Shots at a unit standing against this wall are penalized: Half −20%, Three-Quarter −30%, Full −40%. Does not change what the wall blocks — set sight separately. Melee ignores cover. Only the wall the unit stands against counts.

Props.Title: Cover Props
Props.Open: Cover props — drag onto the map
Props.Hint: Drag a prop onto the map to place it. Units standing against it are harder to hit from the far side (Half −20%, Three-Quarter −30%, Full −40%). Props block movement but never sight. Props can be shot from attack targeting — hitting a Fuel Barrel detonates it: everyone nearby takes blast damage and other barrels chain-explode.

Explosion.Title: Explosion
Explosion.Damage: Blast damage: {damage} ({formula}) to everyone in the blast radius.

Sheet.FactionHint: Faction follows the token's disposition: Hostile = enemy side, otherwise player side.
Sheet.SideHint: Where this unit stands in the fight. Neutrals are ignored by the AI, by overwatch, and by victory checks.
Sheet.NoWeapons: No weapons — the unit falls back to unarmed strikes.

TestFight.Title: Test Fight
TestFight.Hint: Creates a dedicated Test Fight Arena map with two friendly troopers and two hostile raiders, restores everyone to full health, and starts a fresh combat. Running it again resets the same fight.
TestFight.Started: Test fight started — 2 friendly vs 2 hostiles at full health.
